criterion: The map layer selector includes Service as a selectable layer.
steps_taken: Navigated to the launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS; waited for the map to finish loading.
Opened Automobile Add layer, opened Test type, and selected Service.
Verified Service displayed as the selected test type with Add layer available; captured final state and URL.
Cancelled the dialog; no layer was added.
reason: Service is selectable through Automobile > Test type.

criterion: With Service unselected, the map displays no Service test-result points.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for Loading map to disappear.
Observed Automobile not added and no Service test-result points on the displayed map; captured separate map and final images and final URL.
reason: No Service result points were visible on the displayed map with Automobile/Service unselected. Basemap labels and airport symbols were present; no added Service layer.

criterion: When the user selects Service and matching authorised results are available, each matching result is displayed as a selectable map point.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for map loading to finish.
Clicked Automobile row, which added default HTTP Browsing; the subsequent wait for Test type timed out. Captured and removed that test-created layer.
Opened Automobile via its Add layer button, opened Test type, selected Service, and added the configured layer.
Verified Automobile - Service selected. Both Service points requests returned HTTP 500; no selectable Service result points became available.
Captured final state and URL, then removed the test-created Service layer.
reason: Matching authorised results could not be established because /api/platform/automobile/service/points returned HTTP 500 for both requested tile batches. This is a service-access blocker, not proof of empty data or a criterion failure. The same HTTP 500 was observed across criteria 3–9 after independent launcher starts, so a working Service points endpoint is a prerequisite.

criterion: When the user selects a Service result point and its details load successfully, a Service details dialog displays MSISDN, Test Time, Signal, Band, Service, Data Technology, PLMN and Serving Cell.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL, waited for the visible launcher, and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for Loading map to disappear.

An initial attempt to locate Automobile through the code tool timed out before the dialog opened. Restarted independently from the launcher and captured a fresh initial state. An unrelated Surveyor - Download selection appeared in this run and was left untouched; cleanup removed Service only.
Opened the Automobile Add layer dialog, opened Test type, selected Service, and captured each transition.
Added the configured Service layer and observed Automobile - Service selected; both Service points requests returned HTTP 500 and no selectable Service result became available.
Captured final state and actual current URL before cleanup.
Removed only the test-created Automobile - Service layer and captured cleanup.
reason: Service points endpoint /api/platform/automobile/service/points consistently returned HTTP 500 for both tile batches. Matching authorised data could not be established; this was not a confirmed empty result set. Could not open a Service details dialog or inspect its required fields. A working Service points endpoint is required before this criterion can be decided.
